$comment: Routes prerendered to static HTML after `vite build` (see scripts/prerender.mjs).
Only public, unauthenticated, indexable routes belong here. Anything behind
ProtectedRoute would snapshot a logged-out redirect, and anything noindex gains
Blog posts and other DB-backed routes are discovered at build time instead — see
the `dynamic` section below — because their slugs are not known statically.
Each entry runs a PostgREST query against VITE_SUPABASE_URL and expands one route
per row. Skipped with a warning when Supabase credentials are absent from the build
environment, so a credential-less build still succeeds with the static routes.
pseo_pages.slug already contains its own multi-segment path prefix, so the pattern only adds the /guides mount point.
tier=lte.1 matches MAX_INDEXABLE_TIER in src/lib/pseo/indexability.ts, which explains why the cluster is gated.
Guides below that tier carry noindex, so prerendering them would spend build time producing static HTML for pages we are asking Google to ignore. They still render client-side for users.
Raise this alongside MAX_INDEXABLE_TIER and the copy in supabase/functions/generate-sitemap/index.ts.
